name: Brutus step 2: his fight. Into a field of the player's own, he butts (cow_boss_attack 13783), then after four or five butts a special: his charge (cow_boss_charge 13778, *growls*) or his stomp (cow_boss_stomp 13785, *snorts*). Out by the gate. The turns, the stomp's tiles and the *huff* are in HeadlessBrutusFightTest
